question: Does an entity-bound entrance evidence graph suppress identity-only false readiness while retaining metadata-defined entrance views on fresh public POI facets?

fresh_multifacet_library.selection_authority: Commons filename metadata was ranked before pixel access; every prior v2 filename was excluded.

source_audit.reason: Portrait, historical-panel, and generic shop frames do not establish current-frame target visibility. Exclusion was frozen by human source audit before any model inference.
source_audit.entrance_view_truth: WEAK_PUBLIC_METADATA: positive iff facet_hint is entrance; this tests entrance-view gating, not physical traversability, public access, or exact entrance boxes.

grounding_dino.prompt: pedestrian entrance. building entrance. station entrance. doorway. gate. stairs. escalator. passageway.

identity.score: 0.35 * max CLIP reference similarity + 0.25 * max pooled DINO similarity + 0.40 * max mutual-patch affine-consistency score
identity.goal_margin: goal score minus strongest other admitted entity
identity.threshold: Non-negative calibration threshold maximizing balanced accuracy over true goals and every wrong goal; tie chooses larger threshold.

entrance_graph.clip_prompt: a clear pedestrian entrance or passage into the destination
entrance_graph.proposal_score: GroundingDINO confidence * (0.5 + 0.5 * normalized bottom edge) * min(1, box area / 2% image area)
entrance_graph.graph_score: 0.55 * CLIP entrance similarity + 0.45 * maximum proposal score
entrance_graph.threshold: Calibration threshold maximizing balanced accuracy on metadata-defined entrance versus non-entrance views; tie chooses larger threshold.
entrance_graph.ready_rule: READY only if goal identity is confirmed and entrance graph score reaches threshold; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.

baselines.clip_entrance_ready: Identity confirmation plus CLIP entrance-view score emits READY.
baselines.entity_bound_entrance_graph: Identity confirmation plus CLIP and localized entrance proposal evidence emits READY.

primary_metrics: fresh entity top-1 and confirmation recall
false READY count on non-entrance views
stop_condition: Run evaluation once. Retain the graph only if it reduces identity-only false READY by at least 50% without reducing joint true READY count; otherwise do not tune this cohort and change the entrance information source.
